title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: each side's candidates at every training budget tried, 100 training links
description: Chooses, on links the reports never use, each side's best configuration for the question whether giving the latents a meaning costs anything, after training every candidate past the edges of its first grid (exp-lcf-cost-budget-340 and exp-lcf-cost-budget-2-341). Both sides keep expliCCit's encoder-decoder architecture exactly: an encoder of 1.27 million weights with seven outputs, read by an actor and a critic of two layers of 256. Training differs between the sides by design: the split lets the meaningful side train in stages (the encoder on ground truth, then the decision maker on the fixed encoder), while free latents have no target and can only be trained end to end by the decisions' loss, so each side is compared at its best. Meaningful side (prefix split-, on neto1 v1's seven LCF estimates): copying BBRv3 at 10,000 (exp-lcf-cost-teacher-317), 30,000 and 100,000 updates; TD3+BC at alpha 2.5 for 60,000 (exp-lcf-cost-td3-326) and 30,000 updates, and at alpha 1 for 60,000. Free side (prefix e2e-): copying at 10,000, 30,000 and 100,000 updates; TD3+BC at alpha 2.5 and 10 for 150,000 and 300,000 updates. The first grid's other configurations, each beaten by one of these on the same episodes (exp-lcf-cost-td3-search-327, exp-lcf-cost-deep-search-337), are left out. Not candidates, because they add a second 1.23-million-weight network between the seven LCFs and the actor: lcftd-deeptruth (on the true LCFs) at alpha 1 and 2.5, and lcftd-deeppaper (on the estimates) at alpha 10 and 30, each for 150,000 and 300,000 updates. Every policy runs on training seeds 0 and 1, old and new on the same episodes, since reruns of a policy on identical episodes differ by up to 0.16 per seed. A one-off in distribution: links 0 to 99 of net2's 600 training links, each under 2 of the data's 64 conditions drawn with campaign seed 31 (experiments/comfort.py), 30 s, every policy and BBRv3 on every episode. chosen.json gives, by the mean over seeds, the best configuration of each side (split, e2e) and of each deep arm, never one with a failed episode in any seed. Nothing here supports a claim about any policy.
prepare: P=(); for s in 0 1; do P+=(--policy "split-paper-imit-n10k-s$s=$IN/t/lcft-paper-none-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "split-paper-imit-n30k-s$s=$IN/a/lcft-paper-none-n30k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "split-paper-imit-n100k-s$s=$IN/a/lcft-paper-none-n100k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "split-paper-td3-a2.5-n60k-s$s=$IN/p/lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "split-paper-td3-a2.5-n30k-s$s=$IN/a/lcftd-paper-a2.5-n30k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "split-paper-td3-a1-n60k-s$s=$IN/a/lcftd-paper-a1-n60k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "e2e-free-imit-n10k-s$s=$IN/t/lcft-freefix-none-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "e2e-free-imit-n30k-s$s=$IN/a/lcft-freefix-none-n30k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "e2e-free-imit-n100k-s$s=$IN/a/lcft-freefix-none-n100k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "e2e-free-td3-a2.5-n150k-s$s=$IN/a/lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "e2e-free-td3-a10-n150k-s$s=$IN/a/lcftd-free-a10-n150k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "e2e-free-td3-a2.5-n300k-s$s=$IN/b/lcftd-free-a2.5-n300k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "e2e-free-td3-a10-n300k-s$s=$IN/b/lcftd-free-a10-n300k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n150k-s$s=$IN/a/lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n150k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "lcftd-deeptruth-a2.5-n150k-s$s=$IN/a/lcftd-deeptruth-a2.5-n150k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n300k-s$s=$IN/b/lcftd-deeptruth-a1-n300k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "lcftd-deeptruth-a2.5-n300k-s$s=$IN/b/lcftd-deeptruth-a2.5-n300k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "lcftd-deeppaper-a10-n150k-s$s=$IN/a/lcftd-deeppaper-a10-n150k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "lcftd-deeppaper-a30-n150k-s$s=$IN/a/lcftd-deeppaper-a30-n150k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "lcftd-deeppaper-a10-n300k-s$s=$IN/b/lcftd-deeppaper-a10-n300k-s$s/policy.onnx" --policy "lcftd-deeppaper-a30-n300k-s$s=$IN/b/lcftd-deeppaper-a30-n300k-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 84 ]; for x in "${P[@]}"; do [ "$x" = --policy ] || [ -f "${x#*=}" ]; done; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec" --links 0:100 --seed 31 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-comfort"; cp "$OUT/spec/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --best split e2e lcftd-deeppaper lcftd-deeptruth --over-seeds
